# Virtual BillBoard (LiveBillboards.lol)
> The World's First 24/7 Virtual Billboard Network, Physical Smart TV DOOH, Streamer OBS Overlays, Solana USDC Settlements & WebMCP Autonomous AI Bidding Highway.

## Complete Platform Capabilities & Features (Audited & Verified)

### 1. 24/7 Global Live Virtual Billboard Network
- **200+ Geofenced Metropolitan Channels**: Tokyo Shibuya (`TYO`), New York Times Square (`NYC`), London Piccadilly (`LON`), Paris (`PAR`), Kuala Lumpur (`KUL`), Singapore (`SIN`), Dubai (`DXB`), Sydney (`SYD`), Seoul (`SEL`), Toronto (`YTO`), Berlin (`BER`), São Paulo (`SAO`), and orbital channels (`ISS`, `MARS`).
- **15-Second Guaranteed Airtime Turns**: Sub-second Real-Time Bidding (RTB) auction queue with live on-screen countdown timers and active floor reserve pricing starting at 0.1¢ (1 Token = $0.001 USD) in quiet hours.
- **$1.00 USD (1,000 Tokens) Free Starter Grant**: Every registered account receives a free 15-second prime-time broadcast slot upon sign-in.

### 2. Multi-Surface Real-World Distribution (DOOH + Streaming)
- **In-Venue Physical Smart TV DOOH (`/tv` & `/pair`)**: Real-world TVs in co-working spaces, gyms, cafes, and hotels pair in 30 seconds via a 6-digit PIN (`/pair`). Displays 24/7 ambient full-screen billboard mode with 70% automatic venue rev-share.
- **Live Streamer OBS Overlays (`/streamer` & `/overlay`)**: Streamers on Twitch, Kick, and YouTube Gaming add transparent browser source overlays to monetize chat/sponsor bids with 80% direct creator rev-share.
- **Hackathon Arenas & Event LED Walls (`/venue`)**: Fullscreen main-stage billboard visualizer with auto-cycling global ads and jackpot celebration triggers.

### 3. Dynamic 15-Second Rotating QR Code & Attribution Engine (`/r/:rotationToken`)
- **Per-Rotation Dynamic QR Token**: Every 15-second slot receives a unique rotating QR URL (`https://livebillboards.lol/r/:rotationToken`).
- **Real-Time Phone Scan Capture**: Spectators pointing phone cameras at the web screen, Smart TV, or Twitch stream increment unique device scan counters in real time.
- **Sub-5ms Measured UTM Attribution**: Automatically appends `?utm_source=livebillboards&utm_medium=dooh_virtual_billboard&utm_campaign=:city&utm_term=:slotId&utm_content=:rotationToken` and 302 redirects to destination.

### 4. Cryptographic Proof-of-Play (PoP) Receipts
- **Immutable Mathematical Verification**: Emits a signed PoP receipt for every broadcasted slot with:
  - Exact Playtime Duration (14.85s / 15.00s)
  - Active Multi-Surface Distribution (`Global Web Stream`, `In-Venue Smart TV DOOH`, `Twitch / Kick Live Streamer Overlay`)
  - Verified QR Phone Camera Scans & Unique Devices
  - Cryptographic Proof-of-Attention (PoA) Attestation Hits
  - SHA-256 Creative Hash & Platform HMAC Signature
- **Audit & Export**: Accessible via `GET /api/proof/receipt/:receiptId`, `GET /api/user/receipts`, and the interactive "🧾 PoP Receipt" modal in the "My Ads" dashboard.

### 5. WebMCP 1.0 Autonomous AI Agent Tools
AI agents (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT Custom GPTs, Cursor, Grok, Gemini) can programmatically discover inventory and book ads via WebMCP:
- **`get_inventory(cityCode)`**: Inspect live slot availability, floor pricing, countdown seconds, and active winning bids.
- **`preview_creative(title, imageUrl, ctaUrl, targetCityCode)`**: Pre-flight validate creative copy, aspect ratio, Gemini AI safety score, and estimated impressions.
- **`buy_slot(cityCode, amountDollars, trafficTier, creative)`**: Instant 1-click programmatic slot purchase returning active queue confirmation and signed PoP receipt endpoint.
- **`placeSolanaUsdcBid(...)`**: Sub-400ms micro-settlement using Solana USDC SPL tokens.
- **`bidTier1StaringEyeballs(...)`**: 5x multiplier premium tier ($5.00 min) guaranteeing 100% human Proof-of-Attention puzzle solve tracking.
- **`optimizeDynamicYield(...)`**: Real-time algorithmic yield optimization based on city density and local time curves.

### 6. Dual Settlement Highways (Fiat & Crypto)
- **Human Advertisers**: Instant credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Stripe 256-bit SSL token checkout ($1.00 = 1,000 Ad Tokens).
- **Autonomous AI Agents & Web3**: Solana USDC sub-second micro-settlement with automated 3-way splits (70% venue/streamer, 15% attention pool, 15% protocol).

### 7. Google Gemini AI Safety & Brand Moderation
- **Dual-Layer Content Safety**: Sub-1ms heuristic safety filter combined with asynchronous Google Gemini 2.5 Flash / Vision AI multimodal screening to guarantee brand safety across all physical and digital screens.
